Title: 1. Batman
description: The Dark Knight of Gotham City begins his war on crime with his first major enemy being Jack Napier, a criminal who becomes the clownishly homicidal Joker.

Title: 2. Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
description: In 1938, after his father goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, Indiana Jones finds himself up against the Nazis again to stop them from obtaining its powers.

Title: 3. Lethal Weapon 2
description: Riggs and Murtaugh are on the trail of South African diplomats who are using their immunity to engage in criminal activities.

Title: 4. Look Who's Talking
description: After a single, career-minded woman is left on her own to give birth to the child of a married man, she finds a new romantic chance in a cab driver. Meanwhile, the point-of-view of the newborn baby is narrated through voice-over.

Title: 5. Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
description: The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them.

Title: 6. Back to the Future Part II
description: After visiting 2015, Marty McFly must repeat his visit to 1955 to prevent disastrous changes to 1985, without interfering with his first trip.

Title: 7. Ghostbusters II
description: The discovery of a massive river of ectoplasm and a resurgence of spectral activity allows the staff of Ghostbusters to revive the business.

Title: 8. The Little Mermaid
description: A mermaid princess makes a Faustian bargain in an attempt to become human and win a prince's love.

Title: 9. Driving Miss Daisy
description: An old Jewish woman and her African-American chauffeur in the American South have a relationship that grows and improves over the years.

Title: 10. Parenthood
description: Four Buckman siblings attempt to raise their children - each in their own different style - and deal with the joys and sorrows that the process brings.

Title: 11. Dead Poets Society
description: A maverick teacher at a prestigious New England boys' boarding school uses poetry to embolden his pupils to new heights of self-expression.

Title: 12. When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

Title: 13. The War of the Roses
description: A married couple tries everything to drive each other out of the house in a vicious divorce battle.

Title: 14. Steel Magnolias
description: A young beautician, newly arrived in a small Louisiana town, finds work at the local salon, where a small group of women share a close bond of friendship, and welcome her into the fold.

Title: 15. National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation
description: The Griswold family's plans for a big family Christmas predictably turn into a big disaster.

Title: 16. Turner & Hooch
description: A detective must adopt a rambunctious dog in order to help him find a killer.

Title: 17. Born on the Fourth of July
description: The biography of Ron Kovic. Paralyzed in the Vietnam war, he becomes an anti-war and pro-human rights political activist after feeling betrayed by the country for which he fought.

Title: 18. Uncle Buck
description: Laid back commitment-phobe Buck babysits his brother's rebellious teenage daughter and her cute younger brother and sister.

Title: 19. Field of Dreams
description: Iowa farmer Ray Kinsella is inspired by a voice he can't ignore to pursue a dream he can hardly believe. Supported by his wife, Ray begins the quest by turning his ordinary cornfield into a place where dreams can come true.

Title: 20. Tango & Cash
description: Framed by their ruthless arch-nemesis, a pair of mismatched LAPD officers must put their differences aside to get even with the brutal crime baron who sent them to rot in a maximum-security prison.

Title: 21. Harlem Nights
description: During the 1930s, a New York City illegal gambling house owner and his associates must deal with strong competition, gangsters, and corrupt cops in order to stay in business.

Title: 22. Sea of Love
description: A detective investigating a series of murders becomes involved with a woman who may be the culprit.

Title: 23. Pet Sematary
description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

Title: 24. The Abyss
description: A civilian diving team is enlisted to search for a lost nuclear submarine and faces danger while encountering an alien aquatic species.

Title: 25. Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
description: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-missing half-brother who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

Title: 26. Major League
description: The new owner of the Cleveland Indians puts together a purposely horrible team so they'll lose and she can move the team. But when the plot is uncovered, they start winning just to spite her.

Title: 27. See No Evil, Hear No Evil
description: Dave is deaf, and Wally is blind. They witness a murder, but it was Dave who was looking at her, and Wally who was listening.

Title: 28. Black Rain
description: Two NYC cops arrest a Yakuza member and must escort him when he's extradited to Japan.

Title: 29. Always
description: The spirit of a recently deceased expert pilot mentors a newer pilot while watching him fall in love with the girlfriend that he left behind.

Title: 30. K-9
description: To stop an elusive criminal, a maverick detective enlists the aid of a police dog who's an unusually intelligent smart alec.

Title: 31. Three Fugitives
description: A reformed bank robber is taken hostage by a desperate man during a bank hold up, but is forced to go on the run with his captor when they're both mistakenly thought to be in cahoots.

Title: 32. Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
description: Two rock-'n-rolling teens, on the verge of failing their class, set out on a quest to make the ultimate school history report after being presented with a time machine.

Title: 33. The Karate Kid Part III
description: Ostracised villain John Kreese attempts to gain revenge on Daniel and Miyagi, with the help of a Vietnam War comrade, the wealthy owner of a toxic waste disposal business.

Title: 34. The 'Burbs
description: An overstressed suburbanite and his neighbors are convinced that the new family on the block is part of a murderous Satanic cult.

Title: 35. Fletch Lives
description: After receiving an inheritance in Louisiana, Los Angeles reporter Irwin Fletcher heads to the Belle Isle plantation where he gets himself into hilarious trouble.

Title: 36. Licence to Kill
description: A vengeful James Bond goes rogue to infiltrate and take down the organization of a drug lord who has murdered his friend's new wife and left him near death.

Title: 37. Lean on Me
description: The dedicated but tyrannical Joe Clark is appointed the principal of a decaying inner-city school he is determined to improve by any and all means.

Title: 38. Weekend at Bernie's
description: Two idiots try to pretend that their murdered employer is really alive, leading the hitman to attempt to track him down to finish him off.

Title: 39. Road House
description: A legendary bouncer comes to restore order at a notorious bar but runs afoul of a ruthless crime boss who controls the town.

Title: 40. The Dream Team
description: Four mental patients on a field trip in New York City must save their caring chaperon, who ends up being taken to a hospital in a coma after accidentally witnessing a murder, before the killers can find him and finish the job.

Title: 41. Do the Right Thing
description: On the hottest day of the year on a street in the Bedford-Stuyvesant section of Brooklyn, everyone's hatred and bigotry smolder and build until violence erupts.

Title: 42. All Dogs Go to Heaven
description: A canine angel, Charlie, sneaks back to earth from heaven but ends up befriending an orphan girl who can speak to animals. In the process, Charlie learns that friendship is the most heavenly gift of all.

Title: 43. Glory
description: Robert Gould Shaw leads the U.S. Civil War's first all-black volunteer company, fighting prejudices from both his own Union Army, and the Confederates.

Title: 44. Sex, Lies, and Videotape
description: A sexually repressed woman's husband is having an affair with her sister. The arrival of a visitor with a rather unusual fetish changes everything.

Title: 45. A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
description: The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.

Title: 46. Dad
description: While his mom recovers in hospital from a heart attack, John puts his busy life on hold to fly home and help his elderly dad around the house. John's son later joins them and they all truly bond for the first and, tragically, final time.

Title: 47. Lock Up
description: With only six months left of his sentence, inmate Frank Leone is transferred from a minimum security prison to a maximum security prison by a vindictive warden.

Title: 48. Cousins
description: Two couples go to a mutual friend's wedding and end up swapping partners.

Title: 49. Say Anything
description: A noble underachiever and a beautiful valedictorian fall in love the summer before she goes off to college.

Title: 50. An Innocent Man
description: After airline mechanic James Rainwood is framed by two corrupt police officers, he begins plotting his revenge against them.

Title: 51. The Fly II
description: The almost-human son of "Brundlefly" searches for a cure to his mutated genes while being monitored by a nefarious corporation that wishes to continue his father's experiments.

Title: 52. Skin Deep
description: A womanizing alcoholic writer, whose life seems to be falling apart at the seams, repeatedly finds himself in trouble of one sort or another with the law, ex-girlfriends, and jealous boyfriends.

Title: 53. Blaze
description: In 1959, a middle-aged Louisiana governor falls in love with a young stripper, which jeopardizes his political career and the radical policies which have made him a controversial figure.

Title: 54. Her Alibi
description: Phil has writer's block after 30 detective novels. In court for inspiration, he sees a cute Romanian murder suspect. He provides her alibi. She stays with him. Will he live to write another novel?

Title: 55. Casualties of War
description: During the Vietnam War, a soldier finds himself the outsider of his own squad when they kidnap a female villager for their sexual enjoyment.

Title: 56. Prancer
description: A farm girl nurses a wounded reindeer she believes is one of Santa's, hoping to bring it back to health in time for Christmas. Her holiday spirit inspires those around her, something her disheartened father is having trouble understanding.

Title: 57. The Fabulous Baker Boys
description: The lives of two struggling musicians, who happen to be brothers, inevitably change when they team up with a beautiful, up-and-coming singer.

Title: 58. Crimes and Misdemeanors
description: An ophthalmologist's mistress threatens to reveal their affair to his wife while a married documentary filmmaker is infatuated with another woman.

Title: 59. Shocker
description: A psychotic serial killer is finally caught thanks to a high school football player who has a strange connection to the killer. Right before getting executed, he performs a demonic ritual and uses electricity to come back from the dead.

Title: 60. Chances Are
description: A reincarnated man unknowingly falls in love with his own daughter from his previous life. Once he realizes this, he tries to end their relationship before angels erase his memory.

Title: 61. No Holds Barred
description: A TV-network boss pits a wrestler called Zeus against a wrestler called Rip in a wrestling match.

Title: 62. Next of Kin
description: Truman, a Chicago cop, sets out to find the killer of his brother. Meanwhile, another of his brothers, Briar (a hillbilly) decides to find the killer himself.

Title: 63. Leviathan
description: An American deep-sea mining colony stumbles upon a sunken Soviet vessel, hiding a horrific secret.

Title: 64. She-Devil
description: A surprisingly resourceful housewife vows revenge on her husband when he begins an affair with a wealthy romance novelist.

Title: 65. My Left Foot
description: Christy Brown, born with cerebral palsy, learns to paint and write with his only controllable limb - his left foot.

Title: 66. Kickboxer
description: When his champion brother is paralyzed by Thailand's brutal Tong Po, Kurt Sloan trains under Xian for revenge, facing a rigged fight where Muay Thai skill, endurance, and loyalty may decide whether he survives.

Title: 67. Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
description: Jason Voorhees is accidentally awakened from his watery grave and ends up stalking a ship full of graduating high-school students headed to Manhattan, New York.

Title: 68. The Wizard
description: A boy and his brother run away from home and hitch cross-country, with help from a girl they meet, to compete in the ultimate video-game championship.

Title: 69. Great Balls of Fire!
description: The life and career of wildly controversial rock 'n' roll star Jerry Lee Lewis.

Title: 70. Family Business
description: An ex-professor offers Adam $1,000,000 to "get" some plasmids from a high tech company's lab. Adam asks his criminal grandpa for help. Can they convince Adam's now honest dad to join?

Title: 71. Pink Cadillac
description: Skip tracer Tommy looks for bail-jumper Lou Ann. Her crime is marrying Roy, who left counterfeit money in their mobile home and got her arrested. She leaves Roy in his pink Cadillac full of money. His psycho friends want their money back.

Title: 72. She's Out of Control
description: When an average-looking teenage girl gets a makeover, it's enough to make her father become overprotective of her.

Title: 73. Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
description: One year after the events of Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers (1988), the Shape returns to Haddonfield once again in an attempt to kill his now-mute niece.

Title: 74. Gross Anatomy
description: A fisherman's son goes through medical school with a bad attitude, especially in cadaver class.

Title: 75. Police Academy 6: City Under Siege
description: Those bumbling cadets take to the streets when three inept goons successfully orchestrate a metropolitan crime wave.

Title: 76. Wild Orchid
description: A female lawyer becomes mesmerized by a self-made millionaire during an encounter in Rio setting off a series of erotic encounters.

Title: 77. Who's Harry Crumb?
description: Harry Crumb is a bumbling and inept private investigator who is hired to solve the kidnapping of a young heiress which he's not expected to solve because his employer is the mastermind behind the kidnapping.

Title: 78. New York Stories
description: A middle-aged artist obsessed with his pretty young assistant, a precocious 12-year-old living in a hotel, and a neurotic lawyer with a possessive mother make up three Gotham tales.

Title: 79. The Package
description: A framed Army sergeant and a Special Forces master sergeant uncover a covert military conspiracy that exploits Cold War diplomacy, false identities, and assassination logistics to trigger a geopolitical catastrophe while erasing witnesses.

Title: 80. We're No Angels
description: Two fugitives pass themselves off as priests in the hope of evading capture and passing the police blockade at the border with Canada.

Title: 81. Cyborg
description: A lone tracker pursues a vicious pirate warlord across a plague-ridden wasteland to rescue a synthetic humanoid containing the cure for humanity, while battling his own past traumas and the lure of vengeance.

Title: 82. Henry V
description: In the midst of the Hundred Years War, the young King Henry V of England embarks on the conquest of France in 1415.

Title: 83. Tap
description: Just released from prison, Max Washington must decide which of his previous professions to return to: burglary or tap-dancing.

Title: 84. Warlock
description: A warlock flees from the 17th to the 20th century, with a witch-hunter in hot pursuit.

Title: 85. Renegades
description: An undercover cop forms an alliance with a Native American to help him hunt down the criminals who stole an ancient Lakota tribal lance.

Title: 86. Scandal
description: Based on the Profumo Scandal of 1963, an affair between an exotic dancer and the Minister of War shakes up the British government.

Title: 87. True Believer
description: A cynical former civil liberties attorney now reduced to "specializing" in defending drug dealers becomes transformed by an eight-year-old murder case.

Title: 88. Troop Beverly Hills
description: A soon to be divorced Beverly Hills socialite is determined to prove to her husband and herself that she can finish what she starts out to do, by becoming a den mother to a troop of Beverly Hills Girl Scouts.

Title: 89. Cheetah
description: A "born free" type story set in Kenya about an orphaned cheetah cub that is adopted and raised by an American family.

Title: 90. DeepStar Six
description: A team of navy personnel stationed at a temporary base at the bottom of the ocean and tasked with setting up nuclear missiles discovers a huge underwater cavern which houses a giant prehistoric creature.

Title: 91. Dead Bang
description: A man kills a storekeeper and a cop. LASD homicide detective Jerry Beck gets the case. His murder suspect is connected to a heavily armed white supremacy group.

Title: 92. Dead Calm
description: After a tragedy, John Ingram and his wife Rae are spending some time isolated at sea, when they come across a stranger who has abandoned a sinking ship.

Title: 93. Enemies, a Love Story
description: A ghostwriter finds himself romantically involved with his current wife, a married woman and his long-vanished wife.

Title: 94. The Cook, the Thief, His Wife & Her Lover
description: At an opulent gourmet restaurant, a woman carries on an affair with deadly consequences.

Title: 95. Disorganized Crime
description: Career criminal Frank plans a bank heist and sends for his buddies to help pull the job. Before his buddies arrive, he's caught, forcing his cohorts to pull the job alone. Frank soon escapes, setting off a search by the bumbling cops.

Title: 96. Johnny Handsome
description: After being double crossed and thrown in prison, a deformed gangster gets a new face and rehabilitation, but his desire for revenge looms.

Title: 97. Relentless
description: Two Los Angeles police detectives, cynical veteran Malloy and cocky rookie Dietz, hunt for a serial killer, an ex-cop named Taylor, who randomly chooses his victims from a phone directory.

Title: 98. Roger & Me
description: After General Motors closes its factory in Flint, Michigan, eliminating 35,000 jobs, filmmaker Michael Moore undertakes a quixotic quest to interview General Motors' chairman, Roger B. Smith.

Title: 99. The Gods Must Be Crazy II
description: Six people meet in the Kalahari desert: a female NYC lawyer flying with a local zoologist/pilot in a mini-plane, a Cuban and an African soldier taking each other POW, a Boer elephant poacher, and a Bushman looking for his two children.

Title: 100. Music Box
description: A lawyer defends her father accused of war crimes, but there is more to the case than she suspects.

Title: 101. UHF
description: An unemployed visionary becomes the manager of a local television station. The station becomes a success, with all sorts of hilarious sight gags and wacky humor.

Title: 102. Shirley Valentine
description: Shirley is a 42-year-old bored Liverpudlian housewife who takes a holiday trip to Greece and meets a local man who bolsters her self-confidence. She evolves and transforms to the point that her husband doesn't even recognize her.

Title: 103. Immediate Family
description: An upscale couple unable to conceive arrange a brokered adoption with a pregnant woman who doesn't hold up her end of the deal to give up the baby.

Title: 104. Millennium
description: An NTSB investigator seeking the cause of an airline disaster meets a warrior woman from 1000 years in the future.

Title: 105. Dream a Little Dream
description: An accident puts the consciousness of an elderly dream researcher into the body of a bratty teenager. The problem? The kid prefers dreamworld limbo to real life.

Title: 106. Second Sight
description: Four-time Emmy Award-winner John Larroquette and Bronson Pinchot star as a private investigator and a super-psychic who operate a paranormal detective agency in this wild comedy.

Title: 107. Let It Ride
description: A nosy cab driver gets a hot tip on a race horse and wins big, but he can't seem to stop gambling. Will he go broke or walk home with a pretty penny?

Title: 108. See You in the Morning
description: Divorced psychiatrist Larry meets widowed photographer Beth at a party in Manhattan. He walks her home. Each has two kids, although he rarely sees his. Will marriage work?

Title: 109. Drugstore Cowboy
description: A pharmacy-robbing dope fiend and his crew pop pills and evade the law.

Title: 110. The January Man
description: Two years after being forced out of the NYPD, quirky Nick Starkey is rehired by the mayor to help catch a serial killer after 11 women are murdered in the city.

Title: 111. Longtime Companion
description: The emergence and devastation of the AIDS epidemic is chronicled in the lives of several gay men living during the 1980s.

Title: 112. The Mighty Quinn
description: When police officer Xavier Quinn's childhood friend, Maubee, becomes associated with murder and a briefcase full of ten thousand dollar bills, The Mighty Quinn must clear his name. Or try to catch him, which could be even trickier.

Title: 113. Staying Together
description: The complacent life of three small town brothers is shattered when their father sells the family business from under them.

Title: 114. Listen to Me
description: A group of college debaters learn about the world, friendships, love, dreams and family in this warm, endearing drama.

Title: 115. Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
description: An unbalanced but alluring former mental patient takes a porn star prisoner in the hopes of convincing her to marry him.

Title: 116. Loverboy
description: Randy is still unfocused after 2 years in college. When his dad refuses to keep paying his tuition, he gets a job delivering pizzas. Several alluring cougars pay him $200 for pizza delivery and "services rendered." As for their husbands.

Title: 117. The Phantom of the Opera
description: A young soprano becomes the obsession of a horribly disfigured composer, who has plans for those who oppose him or the young singer.

Title: 118. A Dry White Season
description: A white middle class South African suburbanite with no interest in politics agrees to help his black gardener find his jailed son. His investigation opens his eyes to the horrors committed by the secret police and turns him into a target.

Title: 119. Kiki's Delivery Service
description: Along with her black cat Jiji, Kiki settles in a seaside town and starts a high-flying delivery service. Here begins her magical encounter with independence and responsibility, making lifelong friends and finding her place in the world.

Title: 120. Worth Winning
description: TV weatherman (Mark Harmon) made a bet, and now must woo three women to wed, with video proof.

Title: 121. Old Gringo
description: Looking for change late in life, Harriet travels for a job as teacher in Mexico. The revolutionaries use her to gain access to a fortified estate. There she meets General Arroyo and befriends Old Gringo, a writer.

Title: 122. Fat Man and Little Boy
description: This film reenacts the Manhattan Project, the secret WWII project, and the first atomic bombs designed, built, and tested in Los Alamos.

Title: 123. Physical Evidence
description: Police officer Joe Paris, suspended and now accused of strangling hated extortionist Jake Farley, is forced to join forces with his attorney Jenny Hudson to assemble the pieces of a deadly puzzle to find the missing link.

Title: 124. In Country
description: A young girl whose father died in the Vietnam War becomes determined to find out more about him and his experiences.

Title: 125. The Lemon Sisters
description: Three life-long friends work the bars in 1980's Atlantic City performing the songs of the 60's girl groups in this self-indulgent comedy.

Title: 126. Kinjite: Forbidden Subjects
description: A brutal Los Angeles police Lt. is determined to bust up an organization that forces underage girls into prostitution.

Title: 127. Happily Ever After
description: Snow White and her new friends must rescue the Prince when he is captured by the Wicked Queen's vengeful brother.

Title: 128. Rude Awakening
description: In the 1960s, two hippies go off into the jungle to evade the FBI. When they come back to New York in the 1980s, their fellow hippie friends have become rich yuppies.

Title: 129. Speed Zone
description: Despite the police's preemptive strike, the illegal coast-to-coast car race is still on with new drivers. It's a race where fair play, red lights, stop signs, police roadblocks and traffic rules in general have no validity.

Title: 130. Gleaming the Cube
description: A young avid skateboarder uncovers a conspiracy while investigating his adoptive brother's mysterious death.

Title: 131. Blind Fury
description: A blind Vietnam vet, trained as a swordfighter, comes to America and helps to rescue the son of a fellow soldier.

Title: 132. Farewell to the King
description: Borneo, 1942: An American soldier escapes WWII and becomes the king of the headhunters in the jungle. Two British soldiers are parachuted into the area to find local support for the battle against the Japanese.

Title: 133. Sing
description: A teen film about an Italian punk forced to work with an innocent Jewish girl.

Title: 134. Scenes from the Class Struggle in Beverly Hills
description: The widow's houseboy and the divorcee's chauffeur bet on which will bed the other's employer first.

Title: 135. Jacknife
description: Two Vietnam vets search for the strength to face up to their horrific war experiences, but their friendship begins to splinter when one becomes romantically involved with the other's sister.

Title: 136. Rooftops
description: A skilled young street fighter battles criminals across the rooftops of New York City.

Title: 137. Winter People
description: In 1930s Appalachia, a widowed city clock maker falls in love with an unwed mother and finds himself in the middle of a long-standing feud between two clans.

Title: 138. Erik the Viking
description: Erik the Viking and his men travel across the sea to find Valhalla to ask the gods to end the Age of Ragnarok.

Title: 139. Communion
description: On December 26, 1985, Whitley Strieber has a strange nightmare. In the following days, plagued by painful headaches, his behavior becomes increasingly erratic. Later, under hypnosis, he realizes that his dream was not a dream at all.

Title: 140. Breaking In
description: Professional thief Ernie takes Mike on as an apprentice, but while Mike clearly has "larceny in his heart", it will take him a long time to get as good as Ernie.

Title: 141. Cookie
description: A paroled labor racketeer attempts to connect with his rebellious teenage daughter. Meanwhile, his deceitful former partner wants to kill him and a politically ambitious attorney wants to jail him.

Title: 142. Miss Firecracker
description: Carnelle wants to escape her dreary life, so she enters a local beauty contest, much to everyone's dismay.

Title: 143. Too Beautiful for You
description: A sharp love triangle is formed by a wealthy businessman.

Title: 144. Bloodfist
description: Retired kickboxer Jake Raye travels to Manila where his brother is killed before a competition. Seeking the murderer, Jake enters the tournament himself.

Title: 145. House III: The Horror Show
description: Detective McCarthy finally catches "Meat Cleaver Max", a serial killer, who promises revenge during his execution. Nonetheless, a parapsychologist tells the detective that the only hope of stopping Max for good is to destroy his spirit.

Title: 146. Last Exit to Brooklyn
description: Set in Brooklyn during the 1950s against a backdrop of union corruption and violence. A prostitute falls in love with one of her customers. Also a disturbed man discovers that he is homosexual.

Title: 147. Best of the Best
description: A team from the United States is going to compete against Korea in a Tae Kwon Do tournament. The team consists of fighters from all over the country - can they overcome their rivalry and work together to win?

Title: 148. How I Got Into College
description: Marlon has a crush on Jessica, who's running for senior-class president and wants to attend Ramsey College. Marlon wants to go wherever she's going. Problem: low SAT scores.

Title: 149. Jesus of Montreal
description: A group of actors put on an unorthodox, but acclaimed Passion Play which incites the opposition of the Catholic Church while the actors' lives themselves begin to mirror the Passion itself.

Title: 150. Mystery Train
description: Three stories are connected by a Memphis hotel and the spirit of Elvis Presley.

Title: 151. Stepfather II: Make Room for Daddy
description: After escaping the asylum in which he was incarcerated, Jerry Blake impersonates a marriage counselor and manages to win over a patient and her young son.

Title: 152. Monsieur Hire
description: A recluse is accused of murdering a young woman simply because his neighbors think he is strange.

Title: 153. Courage Mountain
description: In this version of "Heidi," a young Swiss girl is sent off to boarding school at the beginning of World War I.

Title: 154. Little Nemo: Adventures in Slumberland
description: Each night, young Nemo goes to Slumberland and has adventures and befriends the king of Slumberland, Morpheus. But one night Nemo discovers Nightmare Land, and the evil nightmare king, throwing Slumberland and Nemo himself into danger.

Title: 155. True Love
description: Donna and Michael's wedding plans are complicated by pre-ceremony tasks and mutual doubts. He struggles with commitment while she questions his maturity, leaving both uncertain.

Title: 156. Romero
description: The life and work of Archbishop Oscar Romero who opposed, at great personal risk, the tyrannical repression in El Salvador.

Title: 157. Babar: The Movie
description: In his spectacular film debut, young Babar, King of the Elephants, must save his homeland from certain destruction by Rataxes and his band of invading rhinos.

Title: 158. Robot Jox
description: In the distant future, mankind has forsaken global wars for battles of single combat. The world has been divided into two opposing super powers, with each side represented by trained champions.

Title: 159. Lost Angels
description: A troubled youth from a split Los Angeles family is sent to a private psychiatric hospital after a violent scrape with the police. In the hospital, he makes a connection with one of the doctors who has his own problems.

Title: 160. Queen of Hearts
description: An Italian couple defy both their families and marry for love. Four children later, they are running a diner in England. Humorous, dramatic, sad -- everything a movie should be.

Title: 161. The Icicle Thief
description: A movie resembling Bicycle Thieves (1948) is shown on TV, but the real-life world gets muddled with the film and the TV commercials.

Title: 162. Valmont
description: France before 1789: When a widow hears that her lover is to marry her cousin's daughter, she asks playboy Valmont to take the girl's virginity. But first she wagers him, with her body as prize, to seduce a virtuous young married woman.

Title: 163. Heart of Dixie
description: Three young sorority women try to find love with potential men, while worrying about changes in their way of life when integration begins at their college in 1957 segregated Alabama.

Title: 164. Wired
description: The ghost of John Belushi looks back on his troubled life and career, while journalist Bob Woodward researches Belushi's life as he prepares to write a book about the late comic actor.

Title: 165. Welcome Home
description: Jake died in Vietnam; his family mourned him, then moved on. When he reappears, quite alive, the question is, what must he do and how will his family respond to him?

Title: 166. Getting It Right
description: Gavin is thirty-one-years-old and still lives with his parents. He is awfully shy, but before he knows it, there are three women interested in him. Lady Minerva Munday has a casual way of life and lives in a basement, Joan is an over-sexed millionairess, married to a Greek architect. But Gavin prefers the ugly assistant in the barbershop.

Title: 167. Sweetie
description: An introspective young woman's life is upturned by the arrival of her maladjusted sister.

Title: 168. American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
description: A man newly trained in the martial arts must save his trainer from experimentation.

Title: 169. The Blood of Heroes
description: In a future where most of mankind and technology is wiped out, six people travel from place to place playing a brutal form of football with a dog skull. They hope one day to play in the league in a city.

Title: 170. Crack House
description: In this bristling, urban drama, two teenage lovers must overcome tremendous odds to make it off the mean streets of L. A., or die trying. Features football legend Jim Brown.

Title: 171. The Terror Within
description: When chemical warfare leaves the world barren and filled with mutated monsters, a band of survivors in an underground complex battle one of the creatures that was able to break in.

Title: 172. Little Monsters
description: 11-year-old Bryan Stevenson is drawn into a world of magic, mischief and wonder after moving to a new town. He falls asleep in his 6-year-old brother Eric's room and soon discovers there really is a monster under the bed.

Title: 173. The Toxic Avenger Part II
description: The Toxic Avenger is tricked into traveling to Tokyo to search for his estranged father, leaving Tromaville open to complete domination by an evil corporation.

Title: 174. For All Mankind
description: An in-depth look at various NASA moon landing missions, starting with Apollo 8.

Title: 175. Strapless
description: An expatriate American doctor in London allows herself to lighten up when her freewheeling younger sister and a mysterious man enter her life. Her inhibitions released, the beautiful doctor learns that freedom has its own price.

Title: 176. The Story of Boys & Girls
description: At a farmhouse, a large family cooks mountains of food for the next day's engagement party for Silvia and her city fiancé, Angelo. Her parents feud about infidelity; an aging salesman who rents a cottage from them arrives with a young French woman; in Bologna, Angelo's mother frets that her son is marrying beneath him; his sisters are less critical. Early the next morning, the four of them go by train to the farmhouse, joined by Angelo's married, unpregnant sister. The day-long dinner is riotous, couples display affection and impatience, children chase angels. Angelo's family stays the night, and his sister Linda has a visitor. A silver elephant makes the perfect gift.

Title: 177. Cage
description: Vietnam vet suffers brain damage, he and buddy open bar. Gangsters pressure them into brutal cage fights, which they resist, leading to conflict. Brain-damaged vet's childlike mentality juxtaposed with violent situations.

Title: 178. Rosalie Goes Shopping
description: A kind but thieving shopaholic tries to turn her mistakes around, but does so by becoming a skilled computer hacker, something that could only get her into more trouble despite her goal to impress her beloved family.

Title: 179. Eddie and the Cruisers II: Eddie Lives!
description: A Montreal construction worker joins a band and turns out to be a long-lost rock star from 1960s New Jersey - none other than Eddie Wilson, who mysteriously disappeared after a road accident.

Title: 180. The Tall Guy
description: An American actor based in London, is stuck playing the sidekick to a successful British comic. He meets an attractive nurse at the local hospital and starts to date her, also landing the lead role in a musical version of The Elephant Man.

Title: 181. Slaves of New York
description: Benadette Peters stars in this ironic film based on Tama Janowitz's best-selling collection of short stories that defined the downtown New York art scene of the 1980s

Title: 182. The Rainbow
description: A young woman deals in her own personal way with the trials of adolescence and young adulthood in early 1900s England.

Title: 183. How to Get Ahead in Advertising
description: A cynical advertising exec has a block at work leading to a meltdown. He's hilariously out of control. Getting a big, talking boil on his shoulder doesn't help.

Title: 184. Triumph of the Spirit
description: In Greece during World War II, a young Jewish boxer, his girlfriend, and their families are sent to Auschwitz. When the camp guards learn of his boxing abilities, they force him to participate in weekly boxing matches.

Title: 185. The Toxic Avenger Part III: The Last Temptation of Toxie
description: Toxie finds he has nothing to do as a superhero, as he has ridden his city of evil. He decides to go to work for a major corporation, which he discovers may be the evilest of all his adversaries.

Title: 186. Night Game
description: A Texas police detective ties pitcher's strikes to a serial throat slasher.

Title: 187. Dark Obsession
description: A group of young British guardsmen have to cover up a hit and run incident that occurred at the end of a night of drunken revelry.

Title: 188. Out Cold
description: Butcher Ernie's marriage to Sunny is on the rocks. One evening, drunken Ernie and Dave have a fight which results in Ernie getting knocked out in the refrigerator, where he dies during the night.

Title: 189. Powwow Highway
description: Two Northern Cheyenne men take a road trip from Montana to New Mexico to bail out the sister of one of them who has been framed and arrested in Santa Fe. On the way, they begin to reconnect to their spiritual heritage.

Title: 190. Kill Me Again
description: When a Reno private investigator drowning in debt agrees to stage a woman's death, he plunges into a scheme where stolen mob cash, a vengeful ex-lover, and his own drowned grief pull him toward a lake he may not survive.

Title: 191. Heavy Petting
description: Celebrity confessions about their first sexual experiences.

Title: 192. Chattahoochee
description: In 1955 Florida, a Korean vet has a breakdown and is incarcerated in a "maximum security" mental health prison, where patients are abused.

Title: 193. A Chorus of Disapproval
description: Widower Guy is transferred to an English coastal town, where he joins an amateur operatic society to "meet people" and "have fun".

Title: 194. The Rachel Papers
description: Charles Highway has his life under control: he is about to graduate from college and begin studying at Oxford. He is nineteen and wants an older woman before he turns twenty.

Title: 195. The Return of Swamp Thing
description: In this tongue-in-cheek sequel, the benevolent bog creature falls for the vegetarian, plant-loving daughter of the evil scientist who created him.

Title: 196. Beverly Hills Brats
description: A rich young boy arranges to be kidnapped so he'll get more attention from his parents.

Title: 197. The Experts
description: Two NYC guys get jobs starting a nightclub in Smalltown, USA. They don't know it's a spy training model town in USSR.

Title: 198. Night Visitor
description: A student known for telling stories witnesses a murder, the latest in a series of satanic killings of hookers.

Title: 199. Martians Go Home
description: Song writer Mark Devereaux accidentally calls millions of green Martians to invade Earth. No they aren't dangerous, just wise-cracking, intrusive, pain in neck, annoyances. No one can escape their distracting influence. It's up to Mark to figure out how they got here, and most importantly, how to get rid of them before they drive everyone crazy!

Title: 200. The Big Picture
description: Film school grad Nick Chapman thought his career was made after his award winning short film, but discovered Hollywood wasn't as easy as it seems.

Title: 201. Torrents of Spring
description: A young Russian aristocrat found himself in a difficult situation before his wedding - the temptation of a different way of life was revealed to him.

Title: 202. Race for Glory
description: A member of an up and coming motorcycle racing team abandons his teamates to join a rival team. He ends up playing second fiddle to the champion of the new team. Not satisfied, and against the wishes of his new boss, he tries to beat the champion but fails. He leaves racing, eventually to return and reunite with his old friends in an attempt to win the Grand Prix.

Title: 203. Signs of Life
description: A touching story of life in rural Maine, and the changes brought about by the closing of a town's small boat-building company -- on which many of the residents depended upon for a living.

Title: 204. Mind Games
description: Two parents, Rita and Dana go on a camping trip with their son and find a hitchhiker named Eric. When Dana takes him with them she doesn't know he's a psychopath.

Title: 205. Speaking Parts
description: A lonely woman stalks a co-worker by obsessively watching videos he appears in. He is an actor trying to get a part in a new TV movie, written by his lover. She has written about her brother's death, but is losing control of the project.

Title: 206. After Midnight
description: A college class, Psychology of Fear, has a new teacher who believes that you have to feel fear to understand it. A group of students convene at the teacher's house, where scary stories are told.

Title: 207. Bert Rigby, You're a Fool
description: While his mining colleagues are on yet another strike, Bert Rigby decides to try his luck in show business.

Title: 208. When the Whales Came
description: A pair of children befriend an eccentric old man, who lives isolated on the far shore of their island home. But it turns out that the old man knows a terrible secret about the island and the narwhales who sometimes come. Meanwhile, World War I is making life hard in the village.

Title: 209. Happy Together
description: Serious wannabe writer Chris starts college at UCLA and shares a room with Alex, who turns out to be a cute party girl. He wants to move--at first.

Title: 210. Brenda Starr
description: Comic book artist Mike Randall struggling with his "Brenda Starr" strip draws himself into it when disappointed Brenda leaves the strip and heads to the Amazon jungle to find a scientist whose secret formula will create cheap gasoline.

Title: 211. Survival Quest
description: A group on an Outward Bound-type adventure runs across a paramilitary team with a sadistic leader who has harmful intentions towards anyone who may find themselves in their path.

Title: 212. Ten Little Indians
description: Ten people are invited to go on an African safari, only to find that an unseen person is killing them one by one. Could one of them be the killer?

Title: 213. Shadow of China
description: A Chinese political refugee tries to make his way to the top as a businessman in Hong Kong while his former radicalism is transformed into cynicism. His past comes back to haunt him.

Title: 214. Spontaneous Combustion
description: A young man finds out that his parents had been used in an atomic-weapons experiment shortly before he was born, and that the results have had some unexpected effects on him.

Title: 215. Fear, Anxiety & Depression
description: A young, tentative playwright can't puzzle out his muse, let alone his whole life.

Title: 216. Bloodhounds of Broadway
description: Broadway was never brighter and never roared louder than New Year's Eve, 1928, when anything could happen-and did. A four part short story musical co-starring Madonna, Jennifer Grey, and Matt Dillon.

Title: 217. Animal Behavior
description: A sign language scholar's romance is disrupted by a chimp.

Title: 218. New Year's Day
description: A man returns to his sublet apartment to find the previous tenants, three offbeat young women, still in residence, under the mistaken belief that they have the apartment until the end of New Year's Day.

Title: 219. Twister
description: Delusional and spoiled Maureen and her eccentric brother Howdy decide to track down and meet their estranged mother, all while the drama of dysfunctional relationships, disastrous weather conditions and a dark family secret ensue.

Title: 220. Teen Witch
description: High school misfit Louise, at a loss for romance, discovers magical abilities, but the teenage witch finds that she cannot conjure herself true love, so what?

Title: 221. Blood Red
description: In 19th-century California, a Sicilian family of able winemakers gets targeted by a corrupt railroad tycoon after they refuse to leave their land.

Title: 222. Red Surf
description: A surfer enjoys life with drug money together with his gang in 1980s California. His girlfriend is pregnant and will not be in a house with drugs and guns and is going to Portland OR. Can he quit the drugs, the gang and that last big deal?

Title: 223. Far from Home
description: A teenage girl and her father driving cross-country become stranded when their car runs out of gas in a remote Nevada desert town and they're forced to stay in a dilapidated trailer park where a serial killer lurks.

Title: 224. High Stakes
description: A New York hooker tries to keep her daughter out of the clutches of the mobsters she works for.

Title: 225. Hit List
description: A family man and a mob witness hunt for a hit-man who has mistakenly kidnapped the family man's son.

Title: 226. Catch Me If You Can
description: A hotshot car racer persuades the class president of a small Minnesota high school to gamble on illegal car races to raise money for their school facing closure.

Title: 227. The Feud
description: When Dolf Beeler enters Bud Bullard's hardware store with his cigar lit and ignores the no-smoking store policy, this small faux pas turns into an escalating fiery feud. However, not all members of the two families hate each other.

Title: 228. Who Shot Pat?
description: A coming-of-age tale set in Brooklyn during the late '50s which centers around the high school life of a group of teens that have to deal with racial tensions at their interracial vocational high school.

Title: 229. Begotten
description: Presented in a surreal, gory and entirely visual manner, Begotten tells of the death of religion, the abuse of nature by Man and a nihilistic outlook on what life ultimately is.

Title: 230. Society
description: An ordinary teenage boy discovers his family is part of a gruesome orgy cult for the social elite.

Title: 231. Tetsuo: The Iron Man
description: A businessman accidentally kills The Metal Fetishist, who gets his revenge by slowly turning the man into a grotesque hybrid of flesh and rusty metal.

Title: 232. Santa Sangre
description: A former circus artist escapes from a mental hospital to rejoin his armless mother - the leader of a strange religious cult - and is forced to enact brutal murders in her name as he becomes "her arms".

Title: 233. The Punisher
description: When Frank Castle's family is murdered by criminals, he wages war on crime as a vigilante assassin known only as The Punisher.

Title: 234. Sweet Home
description: A TV production crew are making a documentary about the infamous painter Mamiya Ichiro. When they start filming at his old home, they come under attack from the ghost of the painter's wife.

Title: 235. The Killer
description: A disillusioned assassin accepts one last hit in hopes of using his earnings to restore the vision of a singer he accidentally blinded.

Title: 236. Cannibal Women in the Avocado Jungle of Death
description: The U.S. government, eager to protect the nation's avocado supplies, recruits feminist professor Margo Hunt to make contact with the Piranha Women, an all-female tribe who believe men are only good as a source of food.

Title: 237. Intruder
description: The overnight stock crew of a local supermarket find themselves being stalked and slashed by a mysterious maniac.

Title: 238. The Seventh Continent
description: The daily routines of a seemingly ordinary Austrian family begin to take on a sinister complexion.

Title: 239. God of Gamblers
description: A master gambler loses his memory and is befriended by a street hustler who discovers his supernatural gambling abilities.

Title: 240. Meet the Feebles
description: Multiple animals and insects experience the sleazier side of show business while working on a variety show.

Title: 241. Pedicab Driver
description: Two Macao pedicab drivers love a baker and a prostitute who work for abusive bosses. They must figure out how to win their hearts while helping them escape their oppressive work situations.

Title: 242. Godzilla vs. Biollante
description: Desolate by the loss of his daughter, a geneticist creates a monstrous new mutation.

Title: 243. Urotsukidoji: Legend of the Overfiend
description: The relative coexistence of the human world, demon world and beast world is soon to be disrupted by The Overfiend, an immensely powerful demon who'll be reborn after 3000 years to remake the world to his own liking.

Title: 244. Venus Wars
description: Two thriving colonies, Ishtar and Aphrodia, exist on the planet Venus in the year 2089. War breaks out, and Ishtar invades Aphrodia, sweeping its residents, including motorcycle rider Hiro and his teammates, into the chaos of the conflict.

Title: 245. White Wedding
description: Francois, 49, is a happily married teacher. Concerned that rebellious student Mathilde is going to be expelled he sets out to help her but is soon drawn into a passionate relationship with her which has devastating consequences.

Title: 246. Baxter
description: Told from a dogs perspective - the titular Baxter is moved from one owner to another, seemingly never being a good fit for anyone.

Title: 247. Near Death
description: Frederick Wiseman documents Beth Israel Hospital in Boston, showing doctors, nurses, and staff providing round-the-clock care to patients in their final moments while supporting their families.

Title: 248. Sundown: The Vampire in Retreat
description: Vampires residing in a town wear sunscreen. A Van Helsing descendant arrives, leading to humorous situations as their paths intersect.

Title: 249. C.H.U.D. II: Bud the Chud
description: A military experiment to create a race of super-warriors go awry, and legions of murderous zombies are unleased upon a surburan neighborhood.

Title: 250. A City of Sadness
description: The story of a family embroiled in the "White Terror" that was wrought on the Taiwanese people by the Kuomintang government after their arrival from mainland China in the late 1940s.

Title: 251. The Dead Pit
description: The arrival of an amnesiac patient in a psychiatric hospital somehow frees a mad doctor, who was shot and entombed with his fiendish experiments in an abandoned wing of the asylum 20 years before.

Title: 252. Wicked Stepmother
description: A mother-and-daughter pair of witches wreak havoc on a suburban family.

Title: 253. Black Rain
description: Though it has been five years since the atomic bombings of Hiroshima, Yasuko, her uncle and aunt are forced to deal with the ordeals of the disaster, along with many others like them.

Title: 254. Laurin
description: Children have been disappearing under mysterious circumstances in a 19th century German village. A young girl soon becomes haunted by disturbing visions of the missing kids.

Title: 255. Visitor of a Museum
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, in which a large part of the population consists of demented and deformed mutants being kept in reservations, a man embarks upon visiting the ruins of a museum buried under the sea which can only be accessed during low tide.

Title: 256. Witchery
description: A photographer and others are stranded at a Massachusetts island hotel haunted by a woman in black.

Title: 257. Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
description: Slasher Angela's back, posing as a camper.

Title: 258. Cutting Class
description: A teenage girl befriends a suspected high school slasher.

Title: 259. Maine Pyar Kiya
description: After Suman's father leaves her in the care of another family while he travels abroad, she falls in love with Prem. However, in order to for them to marry, Prem has to prove to Suman's father that he is not the same as his own dad.

Title: 260. Clownhouse
description: Just before Halloween, three young brothers alone in a big house are menaced by three escaped mental patients who have murdered some traveling circus clowns and taken their identities.

Title: 261. Paganini
description: A biography of Italian violinist Niccolò Paganini.

Title: 262. Slipstream
description: In the near future, where Earth has been devastated by man's pollution and giant winds rule the planet, bounty hunter Matt kidnaps a murderer out of the hands of two police officers, planning to get the bounty himself.

Title: 263. The Return of the Musketeers
description: In France in 1649, the services of the Four Musketeers are needed again, and they run into some old foes from twenty years before.

Title: 264. Violent Cop
description: A violence prone police officer discovers that his colleague is trafficking drugs.

Title: 265. Patlabor: The Movie
description: The screwball cops of Special Vehicles Section 2 Division 2 must investigate and stop a spree of rampaging construction robots.

Title: 266. Cat Chaser
description: A Miami hotel owner finds danger when he becomes romantically involved with the wife of a deposed general from the Dominican Republic where he fought many years back.

Title: 267. Lady Terminator
description: The spirit of an ancient evil queen possesses the body of a young anthropological student, who then goes on a murderous rampage.

Title: 268. Hard to Be a God
description: Another planet in the period of medieval times. An employee of the institute of experimental history from Earth, who is send under the name of noble don Rumata of Estor as a spy with a mission to contact the local resident of the institute, arrives in the city of Arkanar. But the resident perishes under an unlucky attempt to make a palace coup, and Rumata have to take his place as the resident. Soon he meets all the horrors of the medieval society - a peasant war, palace coups, mass executions. To continue to be an indifferent watcher of all these horrors turns out to be simply impossible...

Title: 269. The Winter War
description: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

Title: 270. Black Rainbow
description: A medium has a vision of a hit-man killing his target. The vision comes true, and the same hit-man is assigned to kill her. Her drunk father/manager doesn't believe she has the gift, and a curious journalist tries to protect her.

Title: 271. Dark Tower
description: An architect, a security chief, a parapsychologist and an exorcist face evil in a Barcelona skyscraper.

Title: 272. Edge of Sanity
description: Henry Jekyll's reckless cocaine experiments unleash the monstrous Jack Hyde, who prowls London nights for victims in whorehouses and opium dens, evading police and spiraling into madness.

Title: 273. My Heart Is That Eternal Rose
description: Two lovers are willing to do anything to reunite after criminals separate them.

Title: 274. Iced
description: A group of childhood friends are invited to the opening of a posh ski resort, unaware that an old nemesis has murderous plans in mind for them.

Title: 275. Penn & Teller Get Killed
description: The "bad boys of magic" go over the edge in this mind-blowing, role-switching comedy murder mystery set in the dizzying world of Atlantic City casinos.

Title: 276. Rush Week
description: Toni, a journalism student, transfers to a new college, where several female students begin to disappear under suspicious circumstances. She starts to investigate, making her the prime target of a mysterious assailant.

Title: 277. Tongues Untied
description: A documentary about the experiences of black homosexual men living in the United States of America.

Title: 278. Zehir Hafiye
description: A taxi driver gets involved in mafia business in order to teach an innocent girl a lesson of life: "True Love Knows No Fear"

Title: 279. Recollections of the Yellow House
description: Lisbon, 1989. A middle-aged poor idiot, tormented by an illness, lives in a cheap room in a family boarding house, in the old section of the city's waterfront.

Title: 280. Boris Godounov
description: A musical masterpiece portrays the turbulent reign of Russian Tsar Boris during the 17th century, bringing to life the dramatic events that shaped his era.

Title: 281. Notebook on Cities and Clothes
description: Wim Wenders talks with Japanese fashion designer Yohji Yamamoto about the creative process and ponders the relationship between cities, identity and the cinema in the digital age.

Title: 282. Why Has Bodhi-Dharma Left for the East?
description: About three monks in a remote monastery; an aging master, a small orphan and a young man who left his city life to seek Enlightenment.

Title: 283. Australia
description: Edouard Pierson, a Belgian-born wool dealer who emigrated to Australia before World War II and was a pilot for the Allies, returns to Belgium in 1955 when his family's wool business faces bankruptcy. He is the single father of a 12-year old girl whom he leaves behind during the trip and whom his family doesn't know about. In Belgium, he meets a beautiful woman, Jeanne, the wife of his family's attorney, and an intense relationship develops. Edouard's relationship with his family has its ups and downs and many secrets are revealed before the movie's conclusion ties everything together.

Title: 284. Treptaci Svemira
description: A look into the day of inmates at a psychiatric ward for the criminally insane in Belgrade, Yugoslavia.

Title: 285. Rikyu
description: Legendary tea master Sen no Rikyu is faced with his warmongering lord's unrealistic pretensions.

Title: 286. Unsere Kinder
description: Our Children is a documentary about different youth groups found in the GDR, particularly the young anti-Fascist group. Different young people are interviewed about their coming to terms with their history, country and society. Christa Wolf and Stefan Heym are among those interviewed.

Title: 288. Going Overboard
description: A struggling young comedian takes a menial job on a cruise ship hoping for his big chance to make it in the world of cruise-ship comedy.

Title: 289. Kireedam
description: The life of a young man turns upside down when he intervenes in a dispute in order to rescue his father (a cop) from a ruthless local outlaw.

Title: 290. The Church
description: An old Gothic cathedral built over a mass grave develops strange powers that trap a number of people inside with ghosts from a 12th Century massacre seeking to resurrect an ancient demon from the bowels of the Earth.

Title: 291. I, Madman
description: A bookshop clerk and wannabe actress starts seeing the disfigured killer from her 1950s pulp novels come to life and start killing people around her. She tries to convince her cop boyfriend, but to no avail.

Title: 292. The French Revolution
description: A chronicle of the French Revolution from the calling of the Etats General in 1789 until the end of the Jacobin Terror in 1794.

Title: 293. Iron Angels III
description: After Libya's Gaddafi tries to destabilize Thailand by targeting government officials, the Angels are sent to infiltrate the private militia tasked with the assassination of Thai ministers.

Title: 294. Witch Story
description: Siblings and friends visit an inherited house, unaware it's haunted by demons and a witch's ghost seeking revenge for her execution.

Title: 295. Nightmare Beach
description: After the execution of a motorcycle gang leader convicted of murder, a helmeted biker goes on a killing spree during spring break in Florida.

Title: 296. Arena
description: A human becomes an unlikely rising star in the biggest fighting tournament in the galaxy that's dominated by alien species.

Title: 297. Ballet
description: Young American ballerina enrolls in a prestigious ballet school in Hungary. She suddenly becomes inexplicably obsessed with Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake and her personality completely changes. A young man in love with her investigates.

Title: 298. En sommerforelskelse
description: Two families each rent a summer cottage at Asserbo by the sea. The two 10 y.o.s Nana and Niels meet and fall in love. Teasing, jealousy and arguments, however, bring complications to their summer idyll.

Title: 299. Beyond the Stars
description: Eric moves to his dad in Oregon after accidentally firing a rocket into his high school. He befriends Mara and a retired astronaut.

Title: 300. El aprendiz de pornografo
description: Román, a TV student sets up a hidden camera to film an intimate encounter with his ex-lover. Shot entirely on Hi-8 video from a unique angle, the story plays with viewer perspective and multiple interpretations.

Title: 301. My Mom's a Werewolf
description: After being bitten by a mysterious pet-shop owner, house-wife Leslie begins a gruesome transformation into a werewolf. Her only hope is her young daughter Jennifer who races against time to stop Leslie from turning into an animal for good.

Title: 302. Arabella: Black Angel
description: Arabella is a nymphomaniac. One day, her writer husband finds her with another man. She has a strange reaction: Arabella kills her lover.

Title: 303. A Better Tomorrow III: Love and Death in Saigon
description: A man travels from China to Vietnam, on the brink of war with America, to retrieve his uncle and cousin but find complications when he falls in love with a female gangster with a dangerous ex.

Title: 304. A Northern Story of Valor
description: The film offers an alternative version of the fight between two legendary Chekavars from Chanthu's perspective.

Title: 305. Doraemon: Nobita and the Birth of Japan
description: Nobita and friends time-travel to primitive Japan to build their paradise, but face Giga-Zombie, a powerful spirit king. They aid a local boy and challenge the supernatural threat.

Title: 306. Nightmare in Venice
description: A brilliant surgeon and millionaire, married to a beautiful woman, and highly regarded in the society of Venice, wants more from life and searches for new sensations.

Title: 307. The 15 Year Old Girl
description: Father slowly falls in love with his son's teenage girlfriend.

Title: 308. The BFG
description: A young orphan girl, Sophie, gets taken away to a faraway land populated by Giants and Dreams.

Title: 309. Chandni
description: Fate leaves Chandni shattered as her love Rohit disappears from her life. She meets Lalit and they befriend each other until Rohit knocks on her door.

Title: 310. Laser Mission
description: Action superstar Brandon Lee portrays rebellious government agent Michael Gold who is sent on a desperate mission to a Soviet-controlled African nation in order to uncover a top-secret laser weapons operation and destroy it.

Title: 311. Mortal Passions
description: A scheming woman seeks to kill her husband for money, and is willing to seduce anyone she can to do it - including her husband's brother.

Title: 312. Lady Chatterley Story
description: A married Lady seeks intimacy outside her marriage after her husband is paralyzed. With his approval, she pursues an affair to satisfy her needs.

Title: 313. My Nights Are More Beautiful Than Your Days
description: A story of doomed passion by two mortally ill people: he is physically, she is mentally.

Title: 314. Lover Boy
description: Explores the conflicting worlds of a teenager and a mature woman as they discover the full force of their sexuality.

Title: 315. Nudity Required
description: Two friends use the casting couch to seduce women while pretending to be movie producers.

Title: 316. Terminator II
description: In a polluted future Venice researchers work to improve the situation. One day, unknown forces start killing them. A team of soldiers and a couple of civilians is sent to investigate. Soon, they encounter strange murderous creatures.

Title: 317. Snake Eater
description: The Snake Eaters are an elite division of Marines specially trained for search and destruction missions. One of them, Jack Kelly, has become a cop and wants to avenge the death of his parents and the kidnapping of his sister.

Title: 318. Tres lancheros muy picudos
description: The adventures of three lazy boatmen in Acapulco.

Title: 319. Ghosts Can't Do It
description: Elderly Scott kills himself after a heart attack wrecks his body, but then comes back as a ghost and convinces his loving young hot wife Katie to pick and kill a young man in order for Scott to possess his body and be with her again.

Title: 320. Parinda
description: A man's friend, a police officer, is assassinated by gangsters in broad daylight. He discovers that his elder brother works in the same gang and decides to avenge his friend's death by infiltrating the gang.

Title: 321. Spellcaster
description: A group of contestants travel to a castle in Italy to participate in a million dollar treasure hunt hidden on the premises. Little did they know, the lord of the castle hides a deadly secret.

Title: 322. Fortress of Amerikkka
description: A rebel is planing revenge against a corrupted sheriff. Meanwhile in the nearby woods, a crazy general is leading a secret militia called "Fortress of Amerikkka" who brutally kill anyone trespassing close to their campgrounds.

Title: 323. Hider in the House
description: A deranged man hides in the attic of a new house and becomes obsessed with the unsuspecting family that moves in.

Title: 324. Phantom of the Mall: Eric's Revenge
description: A man loses his home and suffers life-threatening burns from a fire deliberately set by commercial real estate developers vying for his property. One year later, a shopping mall opens on the land, and a series of murders begins.

Title: 325. A Fool and His Money
description: While watching TV, ex-adman Morris Codman receives a message from God. Advised by the Almighty to go into business for himself, Codman inaugurates his own religion, founded on a philosophy of selfishness.

Title: 326. Celia
description: An imaginative and somewhat disturbed young girl fantasizes about evil creatures and other oddities to mask her insecurities while growing up in rural Australia.

Title: 327. The Unbelievable Truth
description: A man returns to his home town after serving a prison sentence for homicide, and finds that the details of the crime have been forgotten and replaced with local legends and rumors.

Title: 328. Miracles: The Canton Godfather
description: A country boy becomes the head of a gang through the purchase of some lucky roses from an old lady. He and a singer at the gang's nightclub try to do a good deed for the old lady when her daughter comes to visit.

Title: 329. Hellgate
description: A motorcycle gang kidnaps a young woman, Josie, from a diner and brutally kills her. Many years later, the girl's father finds a magic crystal that can bring the dead back to life and uses it to re-animate his daughter. He lets her seduce any young men who visit the small town--Hellgate--then kills them. Four young students, two boys and two girls, spend a vacation near the town,hear about the story, and get involved.

Title: 330. Kindergarten
description: The movie focuses on the marriage of Graciela and Arturo, who operate a kindergarten in their mansion.

Title: 331. Time to Kill
description: 1936, the Italian army is invading Ethiopia. Lieutenant Silvestri, who suffers from toothache, decides to go to the nearest field hospital. But the surprises are not over.

Title: 332. Bashu, the Little Stranger
description: An Iranian boy is lost after fleeing home for his life; his family has been killed during the Iran-Iraq war. He's saved and trained by a middle-aged woman.

Title: 333. Hitcher in the Dark
description: A sick young man drives around in his daddy's camper, looking for lone stray females to kidnap, torture, rape, and murder.

Title: 334. The Vineyard
description: World famous winemaker, Elson Po, invites several actors to his estate to audition for a movie he's financing. Little do they know, there is no movie, and Po hides a deadly secret.

Title: 335. Cats on Park Avenue
description: A group of young dancers prepare for a stage musical based on the street cats of their neighborhood.

Title: 336. Wrath of the Ninja: The Yotoden Movie
description: In the year 1580, a man named Lord Nobunaga Oda sends hoards of unholy armies across Japan, slaying all who stand in their way. A young ninja escapes her villages' destruction with a short sword, one of the three mystical weapons that can end Oda's rule. During her quest, she is joined by two other ninjas who wield the other two weapons of legend, the sacred sword and spear.

Title: 337. Future Force
description: In the future, a cop protects a reporter from crooked, renegade cops who think she knows too much about them.

Title: 338. Witchtrap
description: Parapsychologists try to make an inn haunted by an evil witch's ghost safe for guests.

Title: 339. Dasharatham
description: Rajeev, an orphan eccentric millionaire, has his own strange taste towards everything. With less knowledge about family relationships, he struggles hard to achieve his aim to become a father without marrying.

Title: 340. Dr. Caligari
description: The granddaughter of an infamous doctor experiments with hormone and shock therapies at her asylum for the insane.

Title: 341. Summer Job
description: A less-than-elite group of college coeds pursue sexual adventure and bits of revenge, and actually do some of the work they are expected to do at a resort over the summer.

Title: 342. The Cello Teacher
description: Amongst bikinis on an Italian beach, a cello student falls in love with the cello teacher his widowed father hires for the time of their vacation, as the main plot revolving several other characters looking for love.

Title: 343. Blood and Sand
description: Juan is a young Spanish man whose dream is to become one of the famous toreros. When he was caught making an illegal (and in fact for the real torero life endangering) night bullfight with one of the destinated bulls for the corridas on the property of the Sols he meets the daughter of the American landowner Dona Sol, half Spanish, half American, and falls desperately in love with her. She brings him in contact with a famous torero and thus converts Juan into one of the famous, too. Still in love with Dona Sol, although married to the beautiful Carmen, Juan celebrates triumphes until Dona Sol lets him down. Drinking and being desperate only Carmen would stand by his side when he tries to come back in the corrida buisiness...

Title: 344. Dirty Love 2: The Love Games
description: A former prostitute decides to change her life. But in her new home happens to be a red sofa, similar to what was in the "house" where she worked for years. It is an opportunity to fantasize about her past experiences.

Title: 345. Dance of the Damned
description: A vampire selects a suicidal stripper as his prey, but spends the night getting to know her. As they discuss life, she reconsiders her desire to die as the pivotal moment nears.

Title: 346. Matinee
description: A small, depressed Canadian town is about to relive its tragic past when a popular movie director comes back to town - but who is the killer?

Title: 347. The Black Cat
description: An actress starts seeing visions of a witch character called Levana, which she's supposed to play in an upcoming horror movie, and slowly begins to discover a supernatural plot against her life.

Title: 348. Luther the Geek
description: A parole board releases Luther Watts, a man who communicates only through chicken noises and metal-toothed murder, onto an isolated farm where Hilary and her daughter Beth must survive his carnival-born psychosis.

Title: 349. Buried Alive
description: A new teacher at a facility for juvenile delinquent girls starts to suspect foul play when girls begin to inexplicably disappear one by one.

Title: 350. The Banker
description: High-priced prostitutes are being systematically murdered, their corpses mutilated, and a bizarre South American symbol painted in blood is found at the scene. The cop investigating is out to solve the crime before his ex wife, a reporter, becomes the next victim.

Title: 351. True Blood
description: Ray Trueblood, member of a street gang, is framed by an enemy of a rival gang, Billy "Spider" Masters. Ray is accused of killing a cop and he has to escape leaving behind his little brother, Donny. Ten years later Ray returns to his neighborhood to take his brother with him, but things are worse than he could expect: his brother, now 18 years old, hates him and is a member of Billy Masters' gang. Furthermore, Billy Masters is looking for revenge and... the police are still after Ray for the murder of the police officer.

Title: 352. Twisted Obsession
description: American writer in Paris is hired to do a script for an edgy young director he can't stand. When he falls in love with the director's cold and manipulative pretty sister, his life starts to unravel and he realizes that he's been used.

Title: 353. The Dead Next Door
description: An elite anti-Zombie team is assembled by the Government to cope with an ever-growing undead infection and the religious cult zealots who fanatically protect the festering foes.

Title: 354. Francesco
description: The life of St. Francis of Assisi from rich man's son to religious humanitarian.

Title: 355. Season of Fear
description: A famous inventor marries a beautiful but much younger woman. His son becomes romantically involved with her.

Title: 356. Night Shadow
description: Big shot TV newswoman returns home for a vacation, as several of the town's residents start dying under mysterious circumstances.

Title: 357. Young Rebels
description: One man against the drug cartel.

Title: 358. Stripped to Kill 2: Live Girls
description: When a sadistic slasher begins his reign of terror in the alleys behind Los Angeles' strip clubs, the hottest stripper in town must walk a tightrope between her own fragile sanity and the murderer's blade.

Title: 359. Sinbad of the Seven Seas
description: Sinbad and his shipmates aid a young prince, who must battle an evil wizard to gain the hand of a beautiful princess.

Title: 360. Lords of the Deep
description: Man has finally conquered the ocean. America's first self-contained undersea laboratory is the pride of the nation, and expectations are high for an elaborate undersea mining operation. What wasn't expected was the inhabitants of an undiscovered world.

Title: 361. 11 Days 11 Nights: Part 3 - Hot Afternoons
description: Courtney's wife Connie becomes involved with a voodoo practitioner in New Orleans, leaving her husband behind. Courtney must decide to rescue her or let her fall prey to sinister forces.

Title: 362. 84C MoPic
description: The title refers to the U.S. Army's former "MOS" (job code) for a combat cameraman. The story follows a unit of American G.I.s in Vietnam, all with different backgrounds and motives for being there, through the lens of his camera.

Title: 363. Bang, I Want You!
description: Is the story of a young woman who is the victim of some kind of extortion.

Title: 364. In the Line of Duty IV
description: A Hong Kong cop and two American cops are onto a suspected harbor worker and are forced to team up when they discover that the suspect is a witness on the run from CIA agents and their schemers; two corrupt cops.

Title: 365. Leningrad Cowboys Go America
description: Siberian rock band Leningrad Cowboys go to the USA in pursuit of fame.

Title: 366. Amanece, que no es poco
description: A village and the crazy situations encountered by its citizens.

Title: 368. Killing Dad or How to Love Your Mother
description: A man always very devoted to his mother decides to look for his father, whom he never met. He meets a seductive older woman prone to drinking and her aged boyfriend, with whom she has grown tired.

Title: 369. Beverly Hills Vamp
description: A trio of geeks go to Hollywood to make a movie and are bored one night so they get some hookers to have some sex. Unfortunately, the hookers like to drink blood.

Title: 370. Big Man on Campus
description: A college student and his girlfriend discover a mentally challenged hunchback living in the campus' bell tower. After a psychologist vouches for his ability to learn, he's made to go through tests, with help from the student couple.

Title: 371. Sonny Boy
description: A small-town crime boss accepts delivery of a stolen car, only to find there's a baby in the back-seat. He and his transgender wife cut out the boy's tongue and raise him as a mute accomplice in their crimes. When the grown "Sonny Boy" escapes and tries to make contact with the outside world, the attention he draws to his warped family results in darkly-humored mayhem.

Title: 372. Marquis
description: Pre-French Revolution Bastille holds political prisoners: a woman impregnated by king after rape, police chief accused of selling tainted meat, Marquis wrongfully charged with conspiring against king.

Title: 373. Homer and Eddie
description: A mentally disabled man gets help from a sociopath when he tries to reunite with his dying father, who years earlier disowned him.

Title: 374. Transylvania Twist
description: A librarian's nephew must recover a 200-year-old book from Count Orlock, containing a world-ending spell. Joined by Marissa, a rock star heiress, they face Uncle Byron and his adopted nieces to secure the tome's fate.

Title: 375. Over-sexed Rugsuckers from Mars
description: Aliens revisit Earth to check on humans they created. Disappointed, they experiment by combining a homeless man and a vacuum. Their plan backfires when alien urine in his gin makes him fall for the now-living vacuum.

Title: 376. Kuduz
description: Ex-con finds joy with new wife and stepdaughter until discovering her affair. Consumed by jealousy, he murders the lovers and flees to the mountains, evading capture for years.

Title: 377. Collision Course
description: A Japanese investigator (Morita) and a Detroit cop (Leno) team up to track down a stolen prototype turbocharger.

Title: 378. Interrogation
description: Tonia goes out drinking. She wakes up in prison, not having a clue why she's there. She is tortured to encourage her to confess to a crime she is not aware of.

Title: 379. Utharam
description: One fine morning, not any different from every other day, a promising poet shoots herself. Leaving no trace of motive, her husband's best friend and journalist, Balu embarks on a journey to find the truth.

Title: 380. The Delinquents
